title: Establishing Molecular Mechanism of Carnosine Against Hypobaric Hypoxia Induced Muscle Protein Loss via In-Silico and In-Vivo Approach.
authors: Kumar, Akshita; Suryakumar, Geetha; Rathor, Richa
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和动物实验探讨肌肽对低压低氧诱导肌肉蛋白丢失的保护机制，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模无关。
abstract: Skeletal muscle is highly susceptible to hypobaric hypoxia linked muscle protein loss due to disturbed proteostasis and redox homeostasis. Carnosine, an endogenous dipeptide possesses antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-glycation and pH buffering properties. The present study investigated the beneficial efficacy of carnosine in amelioration of muscle protein loss during chronic hypobaric hypoxia exposure in rats. Further, probable molecular mechanism for it's protective efficacy was also established via molecular docking study along with support of in-vivo study. Male Sprague-Dawley rats were divided into three groups: Control (unexposed rats), HH (07d hypobaric hypoxia exposed rats), HH + CAR (Carnosine supplement rats with 07d hypobaric hypoxia exposure 50 mg/kg supplemented). Carnosine administration downregulated myostatin expression levels while IGF-1 level was upregulated and this was accompanied with an increase in total protein content. The expression levels of FOXO, MAFbx, MuRF1, markers of muscle atrophy were also declined on carnosine supplementation. Further, myogenesis markers, myoG, and mTOR were found increased in carnosine supplemented rats. Along with these activities, carnosine also managed excessive reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, protein oxidation and damage. Ergo, molecular docking study supported the fact that carnosine has the ability to bind with IGFBP and myostatin, a negative regulator of muscle atrophy. Carnosine attenuates muscle protein loss via enhancing myogenesis, managing redox, and protein homeostasis. All these activities together enhances protein concentration and ameliorates hypobaric hypoxia induced muscle protein loss. Therefore, carnosine supplementation can be an effective therapeutic strategy in combating skeletal muscle protein loss linked with high altitude induced hypobaric hypoxia.
abstract_zh: 骨骼肌对低压低氧相关的肌肉蛋白流失高度敏感，这归因于蛋白质稳态和氧化还原稳态的紊乱。肌肽（carnosine）是一种内源性二肽，具有抗氧化、抗炎、抗糖化和pH缓冲特性。本研究探讨了肌肽在慢性低压低氧暴露大鼠中改善肌肉蛋白流失的有益效果。此外，通过分子对接（molecular docking）研究并结合体内实验，确立了其保护功效的可能分子机制。雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠分为三组：对照组（未暴露大鼠）、HH组（暴露于低压低氧7天的大鼠）、HH + CAR组（补充肌肽并暴露于低压低氧7天的大鼠，剂量为50 mg/kg）。肌肽给药下调了肌生成抑制素（myostatin）表达水平，而胰岛素样生长因子-1（IGF-1）水平上调，并伴随总蛋白含量增加。肌肽补充还降低了FOXO、MAFbx、MuRF1（肌肉萎缩标志物）的表达水平。此外，在补充肌肽的大鼠中，肌生成标志物myoG和mTOR表达增加。除这些作用外，肌肽还调控了过量活性氧（ROS）产生、蛋白质氧化和损伤。因此，分子对接研究支持肌肽具有与IGFBP和肌生成抑制素（肌肉萎缩的负调控因子）结合的能力。肌肽通过增强肌生成、调控氧化还原和蛋白质稳态来减轻肌肉蛋白流失。所有这些活动共同提高了蛋白质浓度，并改善了低压低氧诱导的肌肉蛋白流失。因此，补充肌肽可成为对抗与高海拔诱导的低压低氧相关的骨骼肌蛋白流失的有效治疗策略。
